1. Online Propaganda and Social Media

Recruitment through religious centers, prisons, schools, or اجتماعات اجتماعية.

8. Use of Influencers or Charismatic Figures
Leaders or propagandists who appear credible, relatable, or authoritative.
They act as role models or ideological guides.
9. Gamification and Identity Building
Use of symbols, ranks, or missions to create a sense of progress.
Appeals to adventure, heroism, or purpose.
10. Isolation from Alternative Views
Discouraging contact with outsiders or opposing viewpoints.
